queue.title: Due Diligence in the Digital Age
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses due diligence in the digital age, key layers, and practical consequences for acquisitions.

Digital transformation expands the scope of due diligence beyond traditional financial indicators.

Digital transformation expands the scope of due diligence beyond traditional financial indicators.

The traditional due diligence process focuses primarily on financial indicators. In a digital environment, within the informational overview of GNK ASG d.o.o. and GNK DINAMO Ltd., that scope must also include technology, data, and security assessment.

A practical approach adds technology assessment as an equal layer of analysis alongside financial and legal review. Technical debt is often not visible in standard financial statements.

The quality and ownership of data assets are becoming just as important as traditional tangible assets in valuation.

A particular risk is underestimating the cost of integrating technology systems. That risk is reduced by involving the technical team early in the assessment.

An expanded due diligence process reduces the likelihood of subsequent surprises after a transaction closes. This publication is part of the GNK ASG Intelligence Desk system and is informational in nature.

queue.title: ESG Reporting: From Form to Evidence
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses ESG reporting, key verification layers, and practical consequences for corporate credibility.

ESG reporting gains value only once indicators can be independently verified, not just formally stated.

ESG reporting gains value only once indicators can be independently verified, not just formally stated.

ESG reporting is often reduced to formally filling out forms. The value of such reporting within the business system of GNK ASG d.o.o. and GNK DINAMO Ltd. comes from the ability to independently verify every stated indicator.

A practical approach distinguishes three levels: the metric being measured, the methodology used to measure it, and evidence that the measurement was carried out as stated. Without all three levels, a report remains declarative.

Comparability over time requires a consistent methodology. A change in methodology must be explicitly flagged to avoid misreading the trend.

The greatest reputational risk arises when a target is presented as an achieved result. Clearly separating those categories in the report text directly reduces that risk.

ESG reporting becomes credible only once it moves from form to a demonstrable process. This publication is part of the GNK ASG Intelligence Desk system and is informational in nature.

queue.title: Geopolitical Risk and Supplier Diversification
queue.content:
Autor: Nermin Sefić

Nermin Sefić analyses geopolitical risk, key diversification tools, and practical consequences for supply chains.

Supplier diversification reduces exposure to geopolitical risk, but requires a clear cost-benefit analysis.

Supplier diversification reduces exposure to geopolitical risk, but requires a clear cost-benefit analysis.

Geopolitical risk increasingly affects supply chain continuity. For the informational overview of GNK ASG d.o.o. and GNK DINAMO Ltd. business, supplier diversification represents one of the core tools for reducing that exposure.

A practical approach requires mapping jurisdictional concentration for every key procurement category, not just individual suppliers.

Diversification carries additional coordination cost. That cost must be explicitly weighed against the value of reduced disruption risk.

A particular risk is hidden concentration through subcontractors not directly visible in the contractual relationship. That risk is reduced by requiring transparency across the entire chain.

Balanced supplier diversification turns geopolitical risk into a manageable operational variable. This publication is part of the GNK ASG Intelligence Desk system and is informational in nature.
